summary: A conversation shows st holding mail while Claude's channel is confirmed, then releasing it, as one quiet pause-and-resume line instead of two lines that read as errors

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: Published schema, operations and contract digest are unchanged.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: stui and st conversations timeline read the claude-channel-unattached and claude-channel-attached entries the way they read a delivery pause and resume: 'delivery paused · channel not verified yet', 'delivery resumed', and a pair as 'delivery paused, then resumed'. A hold that has not resumed stays visible. The Swift and TypeScript renderers are not changed.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or extra startup work.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
